post.description: Self-service: a company and its first admin account. The company waits for the platform admin's approval.
After an admin reset: the account signed in with the temporary password and now chooses its own.
Preview available group keys and counts before selecting people for an export.
The consumer calls this only after WhatsApp confirms the file was sent.

get.description: Download selected people as a ZIP of PDFs or one merged PDF; repeatable until expiry.

Import rows are read fresh (they carry the live progress); the per-import match counts scan the match
history through the company scope, so they are shared for a few seconds between the polls of open tabs.
How long an upload of ``messages`` messages usually takes here (seconds), from the last processed upload.

put.description:
Legacy {term: standard name} save. Terms that stay keep their kind, parent area and note
(set through PUT /glossary/entries); only removed terms are deleted.

post.description: Bring matches up to date with every saved setting (glossary, locations, keywords, watchlist, weights).
Older alias of POST /reprocess that answers with the job itself.

get.description: Listings grouped by message sender or by the phone number written in the bubble.
Areas/developments with their cluster counts, for the cluster editor's area picker.

post.description: Create a cluster, or update/rename the one named by ``original_id``.
Add or update the distance between two clusters (both directions).

get.description: Built-in property terms the matcher understands (read-only, the same for every company).
Frequent place phrases in active documents that nothing recognises yet.
How many unique buyers and listings sit in each status.
New matches grouped by the buyer (``buyer``) or the listing (``property``) they belong to.
Per-day counts for the calendar: how many new matches were found on each Jakarta day.
Badge for the navigation, plus what the latest upload produced.

put.description: Replace the tracked numbers. Company-level setting; only a company admin may change it.

post.description:
Read a CSV or Excel file for "Import from CSV / Excel". Nothing is saved: the browser picks the
sheet and the columns and saves the numbers with PUT /stock/tracked. Company admins only (access.py).
Add one sales number (and its name) to the watchlist.

patch.description: Rename a sales number or correct the number itself; its history and "tracked since" stay.

delete.description: Stop following one sales number. Its earlier log rows stay in the history.

get.description: Excel of the listings of every tracked sales, or of one of them when ``phone`` is given.

post.description: Approve a registration (active), reject it, or pause / resume a company. Paused companies lose their sessions.

A temporary password for a company account (its admin by default). Shown once; the account must choose
its own password at the next sign-in.
Groups to export, each with its ``sections`` (directions, in export order) and ``covers`` (cover pages).

Hand-picked pairs grouped by the person behind each source (the company's sender / sales contact grouping):
one PDF per person in a ZIP (``grouped``) or everything in one PDF, each person numbered from page 1.

put.description:
An admin's decision for a pair. It applies to both directions of the same buyer/listing pair in the run
(the pair appears once under the listing's person and once under the buyer's); ``null`` returns to Jev's decision.

post.description: The latest finished review of each pair (newest run first), for the Jev badge on Match cards.

get.description: Per company: accounts, data, uploads, exports, AI reviews with tokens and cost (all time and the last ``days``).
AI tokens and cost per company per month (newest last), for the usage chart.

The activity log, newest first. Filters: company, action, user email (substring), last ``days`` or a
``from``/``to`` date range (YYYY-MM-DD, Jakarta days, both inclusive).
Daily sign-ins and actions of one company (for the company card).

post.description:
Copy the glossary and/or the cluster table of one company into another. ``merge`` adds what the target
lacks; ``replace`` makes the target an exact copy. The target's results are marked out of date.

Filters.title: Filters
Filters.description: The same filters as the Match list.

RelativePeriod.title: RelativePeriod
RelativePeriod.description: Workflow windows are resolved once when the job is queued, never by the worker.

ReprocessRequest.title: ReprocessRequest
ReprocessRequest.description: Optional: ``from`` extends the analysis window back to that day (YYYY-MM-DD) before the run.

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description: Pairs ticked on the Match page across many buyers and listings, in both directions.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description:
Matching settings. Every field is optional: what is left out keeps its saved value.

``hot_price_floor_pct`` (50–100) and the Warm allowances (``*_down_pct`` / ``*_up_pct``) are
authoritative; the older single tolerances are still accepted from older clients and are mirrored on save.
